ring_policy: Track from real reset, never reset counts/descriptors/history at ARM. Recent PTW64 and comp96 rings freeze on the synchronized first selected-P toggle, irrespective of debt. Complete source-window counts continue through (open,close]. A source record missing from retained rings makes that association invalid, never guessed.
identity: Epoch/reset chain plus fullID and accepted per-fullID occurrence, then exact low30-PA/LEN/SIZE/BURST tuple. Source ticks are for ordering and window receipts only, never subtracted from UI ticks.

header.1: frozen bit0, source_window bit1, armed bit2, errors[63:32]
header.2: live source-cycle count at read time
header.6: source ring-freeze tick (selected toggle after two-flop synchronization)
header.7: total PTW source accepted count since reset; rejects >32-bit identity limit
header.8: total comp source accepted count since reset
header.11: PTW nextslot[5:0], validcount[12:6], comp nextslot[22:16], validcount[30:23]
header.13..16: observed actual per-port AR/AW stream_id (DID), last valid stable value
header.21..24: monotonic per-lane descriptor generations since reset
header.25: PTW local base32 in low32; comp local base544 in high32
header.26: PTW stride8[15:0], depth64[31:16], comp stride5[47:32], depth96[63:48]
header.27..30: per-lane comp accepted occurrences since reset, 32-bit values; ARM preserves them

words.1: PTW/fullID48 source accepted occurrence since reset (high32 must0)
words.2: normal TL request generation[31:0], DID[55:32], ttype6[61:56], bank[62], normal[63]
words.3: full source PTE PA (MIG uses low30)

words.1: per-lane/per-fullID accepted AR occurrence since reset (high32 must0)
words.2: translated full physical address (MIG uses low30)

errors.0: DONE without matching active descriptor ID
errors.6: PTW occurrence32 or source-window counter wrap
errors.7: global comp64 or per-lane comp occurrence32 wrap
errors.8: TL generation wrap or root-supplied source error (including simultaneous AR/AW DID disagreement)
errors.9: comp local two-bit ID nonzero; expected DMA frontend localID0

readback: Source bank registered at0800..0bff. Native bank1000..1dff uses f00 mailbox; dump4608 u64 words, native3584 then source1024. Build identity f01=0x4d444f3130313502.
limitations: No board validation claimed. Root must prove reset/epoch/start chain, private BIT source identity and actual timing. Repeated tuples are uniquely joined using per-fullID occurrence; tuple-only ambiguous joins are rejected. A missing ring record is unknown. One selected episode is not a distribution or performance proof.
